metadata.name: Research Infrastructure Shareable Experiments RO-Crate Profile
metadata.description: An RO-Crate profile for packaging metadata and artifacts of experiments conducted in research infrastructures. It defines a vocabulary to describe entities like executed commands, experiment nodes, and resulting data to enable transparent and reproducible experimentation.

credit_roles.name: Conceptualization
credit_roles.description: Ideas; formulation or evolution of overarching research goals and aims.

credit_roles.name: Data curation
credit_roles.description: Management activities to annotate (produce metadata), scrub data and maintain research data (including software code, where it is necessary for interpreting the data itself) for initial use and later reuse.

credit_roles.name: Formal analysis
credit_roles.description: Application of statistical, mathematical, computational, or other formal techniques to analyse or synthesize study data.

credit_roles.name: Funding acquisition
credit_roles.description: Acquisition of the financial support for the project leading to this publication.

credit_roles.name: Investigation
credit_roles.description: Conducting a research and investigation process, specifically performing the experiments, or data/evidence collection.

credit_roles.name: Methodology
credit_roles.description: Development or design of methodology; creation of models.

credit_roles.name: Project administration
credit_roles.description: Management and coordination responsibility for the research activity planning and execution.

credit_roles.name: Resources
credit_roles.description: Provision of study materials, reagents, materials, patients, laboratory samples, animals, instrumentation, computing resources, or other analysis tools.

credit_roles.name: Software
credit_roles.description: Programming, software development; designing computer programs; implementation of the computer code and supporting algorithms; testing of existing code components.

credit_roles.name: Supervision
credit_roles.description: Oversight and leadership responsibility for the research activity planning and execution, including mentorship external to the core team.

credit_roles.name: Validation
credit_roles.description: Verification, whether as a part of the activity or separate, of the overall replication/reproducibility of results/experiments and other research outputs.

credit_roles.name: Visualization
credit_roles.description: Preparation, creation and/or presentation of the published work, specifically visualization/data presentation.

credit_roles.name: Writing - original draft
credit_roles.description: Preparation, creation and/or presentation of the published work, specifically writing the initial draft (including substantive translation).

credit_roles.name: Writing - review & editing
credit_roles.description: Preparation, creation and/or presentation of the published work by those from the original research group, specifically critical review, commentary or revision - including pre- or post-publication stages.

entities.name: RootDataEntry
entities.description: The root data entity that represents the crate, as defined by RO-Crate.

properties.name: @id
properties.description: Set to './' as defined by RO-Crate

properties.name: @type
properties.description: Set to the Dataset type as defined by RO-Crate

properties.name: contributor
properties.description: Authors of the crate with assigned roles

properties.name: archivedAt
properties.description: If copies of the crate are available online

properties.name: citation
properties.description: If the crate is used in publications

properties.name: mainEntity
properties.description: If the crate contains a single experiment (mutually exclusive with mentions)

properties.name: mentions
properties.description: If the crate contains multiple experiments (mutually exclusive with mainEntity)

entities.name: Experiment
entities.description: An experiment conducted in a research infrastructure.

properties.name: @id
properties.description: Local identifier (e.g. '#') or URI to the experiment file

properties.name: name
properties.description: Name of the experiment (required if the crate contains multiple experiments)

properties.name: dateCreated
properties.description: Creation timestamp (required if the crate contains multiple experiments)

properties.name: dateModified
properties.description: Modification timestamp (required if the crate contains multiple experiments)

properties.name: author
properties.description: Authors of the experiment (required if the crate contains multiple experiments)

properties.name: contributor
properties.description: Authors of the experiment with assigned roles

properties.name: encodingFormat
properties.description: If the identifier is a URI to a file

properties.name: executedCommands
properties.description: Executed commands on the experiment nodes

properties.name: resultData
properties.description: Links to result data of the executed commands

properties.name: experimentNodes
properties.description: Experiment nodes that are part of the experiment

properties.name: experimentWorkflow
properties.description: Link to a file that describes the experiment workflow

properties.name: supplementaryData
properties.description: Links to additional data that is relevant to the experiment

properties.name: includedOSImages
properties.description: OS images that are part of the experiment

properties.name: energyMeasurements
properties.description: Links to energy measurement data of the executed commands

properties.name: experimentController
properties.description: Software or tools used for the experiment management and execution

entities.name: File
entities.description: An RO-Crate data entity for files. Defined as an alias for the Schema.org MediaObject type, listed here for reference.

properties.name: @id
properties.description: Relative or absolute URI to file

properties.name: @type
properties.description: Set to the File type as defined by RO-Crate

properties.name: encodingFormat
properties.description: IANA mediatype or link to contextual entry

properties.name: exampleOfWork
properties.description: If the file is part of a CommandFile or LoopRun

entities.name: Dataset
entities.description: An RO-Crate data entity for directories, listed here for reference.

properties.name: @id
properties.description: Relative or absolute URI to directory

properties.name: @type
properties.description: Set to the Dataset type as defined by RO-Crate

properties.name: hasPart
properties.description: Links to files in the directory

properties.name: exampleOfWork
properties.description: If the directory is part of a CommandFile or LoopRun

entities.name: CommandFile
entities.description: A file containing commands to be executed on an experiment node.

properties.name: variableSet
properties.description: Link to a variable set file

properties.name: status
properties.description: Return code or link to the status file

properties.name: invokedBy
properties.description: If the command is invoked by a parent command

entities.name: CommandFileLooped
entities.description: A command file that iterates over an array of parameters.

properties.name: variableSet
properties.description: Link to a variable set file

properties.name: loopRuns
properties.description: Links to the individual loop runs

entities.name: LoopRun
entities.description: A single run of a looped command file.

properties.name: runOfLoopedCommand
properties.description: Link to the looped command file

properties.name: status
properties.description: Return code or link to the status file

entities.name: CommandFileBootstrap
entities.description: A command file for bootstrapping an experiment node.

entities.name: CommandFileSetup
entities.description: A command file for setting up an experiment node.

entities.name: CommandFileReset
entities.description: A command file for resetting an experiment node.

entities.name: OSImage
entities.description: An operating system image booted on an experiment node.

properties.name: archivedAt
properties.description: If the image is available online

properties.name: hasPart
properties.description: Links to image data if included in the crate

entities.name: CommandFileCopy
entities.description: A command file for copying data to an experiment node.

properties.name: sourcePath
properties.description: Source path of the data to be copied

properties.name: destinationPath
properties.description: Destination path of the data to be copied

properties.name: recursiveCopy
properties.description: If the data is copied recursively

properties.name: copiedData
properties.description: Links to copied data if included in the crate

entities.name: ExperimentNode
entities.description: An experiment node of a research infrastructure.

properties.name: @id
properties.description: Local identifier (e.g. '#') or URI of the experiment node

properties.name: hardware
properties.description: Link to a hardware file of the experiment node

properties.name: topology
properties.description: Link to a network topology file of the experiment node

properties.name: visualizedTopology
properties.description: Link to a visualized network topology file of the experiment node
